targets.query:
SELECT mean("count") / 5
FROM "jmeter"
WHERE $timeFilter
 AND "transaction" = 'Send_Id'
GROUP BY time(5s)
fill(null)

SELECT mean("count") / 5
FROM "jmeter"
WHERE $timeFilter
 AND "transaction" = 'Get_Id'
GROUP BY time(5s)
fill(null)
SELECT mean("pct95.0") AS "95th Percentile" FROM "autogen"."jmeter" WHERE ("transaction"::tag != 'all') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "transaction"::tag fill(linear)
SELECT mean("avg") AS "Average RT" FROM "autogen"."jmeter" WHERE ("transaction"::tag != 'all') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "transaction"::tag fill(linear)
SELECT mean("countError") AS "Errors" FROM "autogen"."jmeter" WHERE ("transaction"::tag = 'all') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
